changeSet.author: metaforge
changeSet.comment: The JPA mapping named this join table from the history side: scheduled_id holds the history id, history_id the schedule id.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE metaforge_scheduled_history SET scheduled_id = (SELECT MAX(r.history_id) FROM metaforge_scheduled_history_relation r WHERE r.scheduled_id = metaforge_scheduled_history.id);

changeSet.author: metaforge
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO metaforge_user_role (user_id, role_id) SELECT DISTINCT u.id, r.id FROM metaforge_user_role_relation x JOIN metaforge_user u ON u.id = x.user_id JOIN metaforge_role r ON r.id = x.role_id; INSERT INTO metaforge_dashboard_report (dashboard_id, report_id) SELECT DISTINCT d.id, p.id FROM metaforge_dashboard_report_relation x JOIN metaforge_dashboard d ON d.id = x.dashboard_id JOIN metaforge_report p ON p.id = x.report_id;

INSERT INTO metaforge_role_menu (role_id, menu_id) SELECT DISTINCT r.id, m.id FROM metaforge_role_menu_relation x JOIN metaforge_role r ON CAST(r.id AS CHAR) = TRIM(x.role_id) JOIN metaforge_menu m ON CAST(m.id AS CHAR) = TRIM(x.menu_id);

INSERT INTO metaforge_role_menu (role_id, menu_id) SELECT DISTINCT r.id, m.id FROM metaforge_role_menu_relation x JOIN metaforge_role r ON CAST(r.id AS VARCHAR(32)) = TRIM(CAST(x.role_id AS VARCHAR(32))) JOIN metaforge_menu m ON CAST(m.id AS VARCHAR(32)) = TRIM(CAST(x.menu_id AS VARCHAR(32)));
